'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Welcome, brother! Say, how do you feel about booze? I've got an order for a large batch of alcohol. Just imagine, there's war going around, but people still drink... Anyway, I need it to be fresh, so make sure you find only the good stuff. You've got golden hands, always find everything I need. So what do you think, can you find me some grog? We'll have a good drink to success after! Some vodka and whiskey would be great for a start. Oh, and get some water canisters too. For the eventual hangover, you know.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 50 to start this quest.
* Obtain level 3 loyalty with [[Ragman]]

==Objectives==
* Find 10 [[Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka|Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 10 [[Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey|Bottles of Dan Jackiel whiskey]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 3 [[Canister with purified water]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 20 [[Bottle of Pevko Light beer|Bottles of Pevko Light beer]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 10 [[Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka|Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 10 [[Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey|Bottles of Dan Jackiel whiskey]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 3 [[Canister with purified water]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 20 [[Bottle of Pevko Light beer|Bottles of Pevko Light beer]] to [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +20,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
* 275,000 Roubles
** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks Bottle [[Hideout]] shooting range target style
{{quote|Good stuff! Come on, brother, sit down, let's celebrate!}}
